pages.text: The Celestial Distributor is a zero-buffer capability proxy. It starts from all adjacent blocks by default. A compatible wrench selects all sides or one of six directions with the same interaction and face arrows as an ME Pattern Provider. Directional discovery starts only on that side and may traverse another distributor, which consumes one of the default 32 target slots without becoming a resource target.

Incoming resources are divided as evenly as possible among accepting targets. A redstone signal switches to sequential insertion, filling targets in cursor order; removing the signal restores balanced insertion. Jade shows the current mode when installed.

Extraction views all targets as one endpoint and does not enforce equal shares. The distributor has no hidden inventory. Only Sky Logistics simple pipes and logistics nodes recognize it; vanilla hoppers and third-party pipes do not connect.
Craft it with Prismarine in the four corners, Lapis Lazuli on all four sides, and a Redstone Comparator in the center. No altar, Eulogia Crystal, or Celestial Stone is required.

Performance: discovery caches the physical slots exposed on the access side. Each extraction cursor position maps directly to one physical slot, so a hit costs one probe. Simulation builds a transfer plan that execution reuses; after budget exhaustion the line resumes from its cursor next tick.

Hold a Celestial Configurator and aim at the distributor to outline every target in its current cache in cyan. The client requests a snapshot only when the aimed distributor changes or once per second while aiming; it never triggers BFS every frame.
